notes.title: MaxControl DevBlog 9
notes.content:
Hello Controllers!

In the last few weeks, an unfortunate development has emerged: Our main investor sadly doesn't have any capacities left to support MaxControl additionally to their own business. Furthermore, our designer and programmer will have to move to save money.
For these reasons, we'll have to reorient ourselves and are searching for an investor again. In spite of our moving preparations, we completed the Headquarters for Global Resource. However, further updates in this area won't be possible in the next few weeks. We apologize for the inconvenience, but this is a big setback for us. First and foremost, we're very thankful for our supporters and fans, because they were who motivated us to not give up through the ups and downs of the last years. We made it this far without a publisher, so we're going to get this phase done too. The development of the game is however connected to large investments of time and money that we can't muster alone and privately. Still, we're thankful for every bit of support and every donation to drive MaxControl forward. We want to thank all supporters once again and will be back soon with new information about the continued development of the game.

Thank you for your time and we wish you a great weekend.

notes.title: MaxControl Devblog 6
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27307460/83bafbb14dbaf62cbacc6baf1b79b142414dc5fa.jpg[/img]

Ho ho ho!

Last week, we had our first meeting with our future investor. It was a short but very productive meeting and we want to express our gratitude for the warm reception again.

Among other things, we talked about our future team configuration. We decided to employ two more people in programming, whom we've already found!
Furthermore, we came up with a plan that outlines which gameplay-related requirements are necessary from our point of view to facilitate a successful launch for Early Access.
Firstly, we'll implement a simple matchmaking system for multiplayer.
Moreover, we want to expand multiplayer to at least 2vs2. To make a faster game flow possible, we'll shrink down the resource system and fuse together build mode and commando mode. "Team Deathmatch" will be our first game mode.

For the Early Access launch, we'll create a new map. Its size will be primarily set up for 2vs2.

This week, we completed the next building for "Team Global Resource". It's the civil building for scientists and gives you access to the laboratory.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27307460/b12235e10c1b5ea7fccfb3837e3388b6bc8cebf0.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27307460/3f54f8e30ec02f9ac95ceed1894b8ddb71fb6937.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27307460/7b983f8461cab8a511bfa9aadac372d6a8e5cddf.jpg[/img]

Of course, there's a new little drawing for the next building. It'll be the future civil building for the engineers of "Team Global Resource".
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27307460/26702dfa59029bf11bfb730f26df51fa1f35abb8.jpg[/img]

This is our last Devblog for the year, but fear not, the next one is coming soon.
We whish you all happy holidays and a happy New Year!

Your MaxControl Team, over and out!

notes.title: Gameplay Programmer wanted
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27307460/4b7b21af913f8d8e43fbaea884cd73c5d0bc03e5.jpg[/img]

Hi folks,

we are Eierkop Games and currently we're looking for an experienced gameplay programmer to support our development team for MaxControl.
For more than two and a half years we're working on our first big project and now we switched into CRY V.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Now we're looking for someone with much experience in programming (C++, C#) and specially in CRYENGINE.
Gameplay and code implementation is a main part for this position.
You will work closely with the team and specially with our programmer Ben, which is one of the founder of MaxControl.

[h1]Requirements:	[/h1]

- A passion for RTS games would be nice but it isn't a must.
- Professional experience as a programmer.
- Professional experience with the CRYENGINE.
- Participate actively in the development by providing recommendations and 
  proposals for the improvement of the production cycle.
- Experience with current PC development processes.
- Work together with us and the existing Engine-code to develop and improve 
  the gameplay for a premium project.
- German skills would be appreciated, but aren't required.
- A solid comprehension of C++ in a development environment for games.
- Experience in the work with script languages and/or node based scripting.
- Good communication skills with preparedness for transparency.

 [h1]What you can expect from us:		[/h1]

- Work from home.
- Communication with the team via Skype, Teamspeak, Discord etc.
- A refreshing atmosphere in a young and slightly crazy team.
- Flexible work time.
- Access to our network.
- Good salary.
- Freelance work possible.

[h1] About Eierkop Games / MaxControl	[/h1]

Hey!
We are Eierkop Games, a small indie studio from Germany (founded 2015), that arose from the passion for games of two brothers. Our limitless fascination for strategy and action games led us to our big dream: To make a game that fuses all our favorite genres into one single game. After more than two and a half years of hard work we've made astonishing progress and a talented team emerged, hell-bent on realizing our big dream. With MaxControl (currently in tech alpha state), we're concentrating on a strategic shooter hybrid from various perspectives. Every playable view opens up new possibilities, either alone against the AI or against other players.
Build your base without limits, order your military across the map with strategic skills or conquer important areas and essential resources. Every task can be taken over by any player at all times, there are no fixed positions.

We've picked your interest, then please send us a description of yourself and your references to [b] job@maxcontrolgame.com	[/b] 

If you know someone who could be interested, please share this post!

We're looking forward to hearing from you.

To get more information about MaxControl and the team behind it, check this out:

[url=http://maxcontrolgame.com/en/index.html] MaxControl website	[/url]
[url=https://discord.gg/23JDCyD] Join our Discord	[/url]

notes.title: MaxControl devblog 1
notes.content:
Our first devblog! To keep you up to date with the development of MaxControl even better, we've decided to improve the structure of our updates. We'll now continually keep you informed with these devblogs.
This is what we've worked on in the last few days:

New in the game:

- Added procedurally generated units. Infantry untis will now be generated when you buy them, that saves CPU power and improves performance.

- Added a minimap to commando mode. In commando mode you now have a minimap. It provides an overview over the whole map.

- Added capture points to commando minimap. On the minimap in commando mode you can now see sectors of the map your troops have advanced into already.

- Added circular unit selection in commando mode. To select units, hold left mouse button and drag the mouse over the units you want to select.

Fixes:

- Selection of units in commando mode
- Health display on AI units
- Reduced strength of AI units by 40%
- AI assault troopers now have a rocket launcher function
- AI can now build defensive positions. They can be turned with 'Q' and 'E'.


Furthermore, there will be a new Dev Insight video this week.

Until next week!

Your MaxControl Team, over and out!

notes.title: What we will implement in the next weeks and months
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27307460/94c4257eca92e4c931279ecf3fb466fdb6eac7e9.jpg[/img]

Hey Controllers,

apologies for our minimal communication with you. Because of health issues it wasn't possible for us yet to bring you any updates.
In March and April we had a bunch of internal tests. This time was very productive and opened new perspectives to us. We don't just want to depend on the Early Access release on Steam, so we decided to start a Kickstarter campaign. Planning and development takes some time and we are not all done yet. Furthermore we want to take on support money and we will set up a donations account on our website. After over two years of development without any external financial support we are now at a point where we need funds to help the team expand and keep working full time. We understand that our miss announcement in December reflected badly on us. We also learned from it and want to make sure now when we announce somethings because we don't want to disappoint you again. We want this project with you and all available resources. We need your help for that!

First of all, Kickstarter, campaign info and date will be announced soon.
When Kickstarter is successful,  a few weeks after we will open the Closed Alpha for all Backers. Then we will work for a few weeks with the Backers to work on the ongoing development.
Secondly, a donations account on our website for support funds.
After the Closed Alpha we will start the Early Access.
In case theses actions won't be successful we will take and list the status quo of the game and start the Early Access with you together.
Your opinions and thoughts are important to us so please  don't be shy and tell us.

We are so thankful for your patience and support!

[url=http://maxcontrolgame.com] Website	[/url]
[url=https://www.facebook.com/MaxControlGame/] MaxControl On Facebook 	[/url]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27307460/372d0937c1c5b734cacee8c662ff8cad9313c36f.jpg[/img]

Hey Controllers!

Today we proudly announce that our very first developer livestream is happening this Saturday!
It starts 25 March at 8:15 PM (CET: Central European Time - 20:15)!
We will be live on https://www.twitch.tv/eierkopgames every two weeks.
On this Saturday we want to show a 60 minutes gameplay in a 1vs1 multiplayer match.

Join us and ask questions about the game.

For further information go to our [url=http://maxcontrolgame.com/en/news.html] 	website[/url]

We can't wait to talk to you this Saturday!

[url=https://www.facebook.com/MaxControlGame/ MaxControl on Facebook[url]

notes.title: Welcome to MaxControl's Community Manager
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27307460/80c81b116f1c5f1f2d974b68f22a5c361b21fc17.jpg[/img]

Hey ho,

how is it going everyone, my name is Svenja, community manager at MaxControl.
Originally from Germany, I’m now living in Australia and I’ve been taking care of social media for the past few months.

I studied Communication and Media Management in Germany and currently I’m in the process of starting my life in Australia, work, family, home, everything. During my studies I was working with a start up, responsible for their social media and conversation with other users online. I also recently started a blog svenjawhateverr.com. I love minimalism, music, gaming and waste my life watching YouTube videos.

I’m excited to hopefully talk to you all in the near future, hit me up in the Steam forums, and on all the MaxControl sites, Facebook, Instagram and Twitter. I’ll do my best to answer all questions and help with any problems!

Talk soon!

Cheerio,

Svenja


[url=http://maxcontrolgame.com/en/index.html] MaxControl[/url]
[url=https://www.facebook.com/MaxControlGame] MaxControl on Facebook	[/url]

Today we want to show you our playable multiplayer soldier for the team Stabil & Gut.
The soldier is a physical strong and resilient unit.

notes.title: Whats going on about MaxControl?
notes.content:
Hello guys!

We wanted to start the release in December. On a very short notice we had to change around our basic concept of the multiplayer. It mainly was about how to start the multiplayer after all. We quickly implemented a new concept but there are a few aspects that need to be developed and changed.
We don’t want to bore you with information that’s why you didn’t hear much from us the past weeks. We’re currently working on performance improvements and on delicate adjustments of basic functions.

We also added a small coming soon list to the game description, we want to integrate as much as possible very soon.

The release date will be announced separately. We are excited as hell about the release date, have a little more patience with us!

Feel free to ask questions and as long as you stay friendly and constrictive.
We created a post in our Steam discussions for all your questions.
You can also contact us via Facebook, Instagram etc.
We will get back to you as soon as possible.

Talk to you soon, your MaxControl Team

notes.title: +++Update+++
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

The standard multiplayer is generally functional now. We’re currently fixing the last problems and ask for a little for patience. We had another multiplayer form set up which did not work on Steam. This is why there were unexpected changes for the multiplayer to be compatible with Steam.
Dedicated servers can still be hosted.


Thank you so much for your patience!

The MaxControl Team
